collection.credit:
* V10 reputation, appointment, school and rivalry events: event prose
  and detailed branching by ChatGPT. Requested social outcomes and
  leadership roles, including ostracism, laughingstock, village idiot,
  mad scientist, trusted advisor, teacher and heads of professions:
  Lorsieab2. VV3–VV5-only Magic/Nature faction rule: Lorsieab2.

ledger.why: the teacher reputation is story only (rule 7)

items.text: a child asks a question (Subject) cannot answer.
the demonstration collapses into a pile of rotten wood.
(Subject) discovers (subject.he/she) has brought the wrong notes.
the children know more about the subject than expected.
a child politely points out that the teacher is contradicting (subject.himself/herself).
a snail crawls across the teaching materials, stealing everyone's attention.
(Subject) admits not knowing and promises to investigate.
(Subject) apologizes for snapping at a student.
(Subject) turns the failed demonstration into a lesson about testing and revision.
(Subject) asks an elder to share a complementary perspective on the topic.
(Subject) realizes teaching is harder than doing, and seeks guidance from an experienced instructor.
The students ask (Subject) to return next week.
(Subject) becomes a regular school teacher after demonstrating patience and reliability.
(Subject) decides to remain an occasional guest teacher.
A child announces that this was the best lesson because "the teacher made the biggest mistake."
(Subject) leaves exhausted, then begins planning a better lesson before reaching home.

intro.name: The first lesson
intro.text:
(Subject), a highly skilled {builder|healer|farmer|researcher|devotee}, has been invited to teach at the local school.
The first lesson concerns {a practical skill|a difficult question|a village tradition|a demonstration with safe materials}. The pupils are excited.
The lesson goes wrong when:

text_only.reason: the lesson's topic, not a skill reward

react.text: (Subject) {blushes|gets defensive|laughs at (subject.himself/herself)|takes a moment to recover}.
